n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
heights = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))

# Function to simulate the landslide
def simulate_landslide(n, heights):
    while True:
        changed = False
        for j in range(n - 1):
            if heights[j] + 2 <= heights[j + 1]:
                # Transfer 1 unit of dirt from j+1 to j
                heights[j] += 1
                heights[j + 1] -= 1
                changed = True
        if not changed:
            break
    return heights

# Simulate the landslide and output the final heights
final_heights = simulate_landslide(n, heights)
